title: Character Development
author: mrdub
selftext: Working on a character to test out expression and gaze controls. Part of a larger project where I am building an automated 2d -> fully rigged character animation pipeline.

comments.author: UAAgency
comments.body: is it open source? looks cool, would love to play with it

replies.author: mrdub
replies.body: Working on improving loading times - currently the shaders and other assets are not optimized. The character viewer / scene is all threejs.

replies.author: mrdub
replies.body: I used splat from supersplat for the grass. Imagegen (ChatGPT) and Flux for the character references and then a lot of image breakdown -> shaders to get the transparent/inner glow effects on the character.
